main_measure.name: slope of drift-removed 5-bar return on forecast (pooled breakout cases)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 (with supporting check), reject if slope t <= -2, at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean drift-removed 5-bar return of breakout cases above 0

decided_by: The slope t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Grid bars are positions 0,5,10,... of each window with a full 5-bar return inside it; the coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean over all its grid returns across windows; the regressor is post_pipeline_value (forecast where it is missing); the situation check uses the raw distance above 0 with a positive forecast.
